# A CAD account that counts whole dollars and nothing finer.
#
# `commodity_scu: 1` is a supported field this tool round-trips, and an account
# kept coarser than its own currency is a book GnuCash writes. Opened on its
# own, with no transaction, so any book can be given one.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_unlinking_a_linked_transaction.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets:Due From Director Whole
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	commodity_scu: 1
